spec.name: A
spec.query: count by (namespace, label_resource_name) ( (kube_pod_created{namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} >= (time() - 3600)) * on(pod, namespace) group_left(label_resource_name) kube_pod_labels{label_resource_type="service", label_resource_name!~"bkout-one-workflow-backend|workflow-queue-workers",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} )

annotations.description: >8 pods created in the last hour for this service - sustained recreation/crash-loop that per-pod restart counters miss (each new pod resets restartCount to 0). Normal = replica count + one rollout.
annotations.resolution: kubectl -n {{ $labels.namespace }} get pods -l app={{ $labels.label_resource_name }} --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp; describe the newest (events: OOM/liveness/FailedScheduling); causes: OOM (raise limits), health/DB timeouts, or cluster capacity.
